hook.say: Turkey's ten highest mountains, ranked. Number one is taller than anything in the Alps!

outro.say: Which mountain did we miss? Comment below!

items.name: Medetsiz
items.say: Number ten: Medetsiz, summit of the Bolkar range. 3524 meters.
items.cap: Number ten: Medetsiz, summit of the Bolkar range. 3,524 meters.

items.name: Mt. Tendürek
items.say: Nine: Ten-doo-rek, a sleeping volcano. 3584 meters.
items.cap: Nine: Tendürek, a sleeping volcano. 3,584 meters.

items.name: Mt. Başet
items.say: Eight: Mount Bah-shet, Van's hidden giant. 3684 meters.
items.cap: Eight: Mount Başet, Van's hidden giant. 3,684 meters.

items.name: Demirkazık
items.say: Seven: Demeerkazik, a climber's legend. 3756 meters.
items.cap: Seven: Demirkazık, a climber's legend. 3,756 meters.

items.name: Little Ararat
items.say: Six: Little Ararat, a near-perfect cone. 3896 meters.
items.cap: Six: Little Ararat, a near-perfect cone. 3,896 meters.

items.name: Mt. Erciyes
items.say: Five: Air-jee-yes, the volcano that shaped Cappadocia. 3917 meters.
items.cap: Five: Erciyes, the volcano that shaped Cappadocia. 3,917 meters.

items.name: Mt. Kaçkar
items.fact: Roof of the Black Sea coast
items.say: Four: Kotchkar, roof of the Black Sea coast. 3932 meters.
items.cap: Four: Kaçkar, roof of the Black Sea coast. 3,932 meters.

items.name: Mt. Süphan
items.say: Three: Soop-hahn, guardian of Lake Van. 4058 meters.
items.cap: Three: Süphan, guardian of Lake Van. 4,058 meters.

items.name: Uludoruk
items.say: Two: Ooloodorook, crowned with glaciers. 4135 meters.
items.cap: Two: Uludoruk, crowned with glaciers. 4,135 meters.

items.name: Mount Ararat
items.say: And number one: Mount Ararat! 5137 meters, the roof of Turkey.
items.cap: And number one: Mount Ararat! 5,137 meters, the roof of Turkey.
